title: Integral closure commutes with localisation
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file algebra.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma states that for a ring map from A to B and a multiplicative subset S of A, the integral closure of S^{-1}A in S^{-1}B is the localisation of the integral closure of A in B (statement lines 7813-7819). The proof does not argue with the module of integral elements: one direction divides an integrality relation by powers of the inverted element, and the other clears denominators with a suitable factor from S to convert an integrality relation over the localisation into one over A for a multiple of the numerator (proof lines 7821-7844). The clearing of denominators is the substance, and the author displays both relations in full. H2.
